needsARealService: A transporter register: search an organisation’s saved transporters, read one, add one and delete one. Plants-frontend has none: its team removed the transporter pages on purpose.

operations.name: listTransporters

params.q: text to find in the name, address or approval number

errors: 400 when the page is out of range

operations.name: getTransporter
errors: 404 when the organisation has no such transporter

operations.name: createTransporter

params.body: name, transporterType, approvalNumber, addressLine1, addressLine2, townOrCity, county, postcode, country

operations.returns: the saved transporter, with its new id and approvalStatus "new"
errors: 400 with a problem body, { errors: { field: [message] } }, for each field it refuses

operations.name: deleteTransporter
errors: 404 when the organisation has no such transporter

openQuestions: Which service owns transporters: a new API, the address book, or the plants backend?
Is the approval number checked against a register, and who sets approvalStatus?
Should country stay an ISO code end to end, or does the real service want the display name too?
notes: CDP dev has no backend for this service, so index.js keeps isStubDataMode() to choose stub.js until a real service exists.
The labels for transporterType ("Commercial", "Private") are journey vocabulary, not part of the contract: they live with the saved-transporters feature that shows them, in sets/sample-journey.
